[[File:Dendhur.jpg|thumb|Den Dhur who used a force-detecting chop]]
A '''force-detecting chip''' was a cutting-edge technology that could detect the increased brain wave activity that a individual actively using [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] emitted. The main drawback of the technology was that it could only detect the heightened brain wave activity within twenty meters. This technology's real ability to detect [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] remained unknown to the only known buyer of the chip: [[I-5YQ]]. [[Den Dhur]] frustrated with the aforementioned drawbacks of the device smashed it.
